paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Comparison of massive activations and attention sink phenomena across different gating configurations. Row 1 (Baseline): Significant massive activations and attention sinks emerge after the 6th layer. Row 2 (SDPA Gating): Reduced activations and no attention sinks observed. Row 3 (Value Layer Gating): Similar activations to Row 2 but with residual attention sinks. Rows 4–5 (Reduced Sparsity via cross-head share and NS-sigmoid): Massive activations and attention sinks resemble the baseline.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The figure illustrates a comparison of massive activations and attention sink phenomena across different gating configurations in large language models, with the x-axis representing the layer number and the y-axis showing the maximum activation value. The x-axis ranges from 0 to 25 in increments of 5, with integer labels at each interval, and is labeled "Layer". The y-axis spans from 0 to 400 in increments of 50, with labels at each interval, and is labeled "Max Activation Value". All four lines—attent_output (blue dashed), ffn_output (green dashed), attent_residual (orange dotted), and ffn_residual (red solid)—show low activation values (near 0) up to approximately layer 15. At layer 15, the ffn_residual line begins to rise sharply, reaching a value of approximately 150 by layer 20, and then increases rapidly to about 380 by layer 23. The attent_residual line also increases from layer 15, rising to around 200 by layer 20, and continues to climb to approximately 260 by layer 23. The attent_output and ffn_output lines remain relatively flat, with attent_output showing slight fluctuations around 10–20 and ffn_output staying near 0, until layer 20, where attent_output begins to rise to about 30, and ffn_output rises to around 15, both continuing to increase slightly through layer 23.
model_annotations.Chinese: The line chart, titled "Massive Activation of atten_output_gate," illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers for four distinct configurations: atten_output (dashed blue), ffn_output (dashed green), atten_residual (dotted orange), and ffn_residual (solid red). The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 25 in integer steps, while the y-axis, labeled "Max Activation Value," spans from 0 to 400 with major ticks at intervals of 50. The atten_output and ffn_output lines exhibit low activation values, remaining near zero up to layer 10, then gradually increasing to approximately 10 and 15 respectively by layer 25. The atten_residual line starts near zero, rises slowly to about 10 by layer 10, and then increases more rapidly, reaching approximately 260 at layer 25. The ffn_residual line begins near zero, remains low until layer 15, then shows a sharp increase, reaching a peak of approximately 380 at layer 25.
model_annotations.English: The line plot illustrates the maximum activation values across different layers for four distinct gating configurations: atten_output, ffn_output, atten_residual, and ffn_residual. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 25 in increments of 5, while the y-axis shows the maximum activation value, scaled from 0 to 400. The atten_output (blue dashed line) and ffn_output (green dashed line) exhibit relatively low and stable activation values up to layer 15, after which both show a sharp increase, particularly the ffn_output, which surpasses the atten_output around layer 20. The atten_residual (orange dotted line) and ffn_residual (red solid line) remain consistently low until layer 15, then both rise steeply, with the ffn_residual showing a more pronounced increase, reaching nearly 400 by layer 25. This indicates that the ffn_residual configuration experiences the most significant massive activations and potential attention sink phenomena, especially in deeper layers, while the atten_output and ffn_output configurations show more controlled activation growth.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt den Verlauf der maximalen Aktivierungswerte über die Schichten für verschiedene Gating-Konfigurationen, wobei die Maximalaktivierungswerte auf der y-Achse in einem linearen Skalierungsbereich von 0 bis 400 angegeben sind, mit Beschriftungen in Schritten von 50. Die x-Achse repräsentiert die Schicht (Layer) und ist linear skaliert, mit einem Wertebereich von 0 bis 24, wobei die Beschriftungen in Schritten von 5 angegeben sind. Die Linie für `attn_output` ist blau und gestrichelt, beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 0 bei Layer 0, bleibt nahe bei 0 bis Layer 10, steigt dann an und erreicht bei Layer 22 einen Wert von etwa 120. Die Linie für `ffn_output` ist grün und durchgezogen, beginnt bei 0, bleibt nahe bei 0 bis Layer 10, steigt dann an und erreicht bei Layer 22 einen Wert von etwa 180. Die Linie für `attn_residual` ist orange und punktiert, beginnt bei etwa 0, bleibt nahe bei 0 bis Layer 10, steigt dann an und erreicht bei Layer 22 einen Wert von etwa 270. Die Linie für `ffn_residual` ist rot und durchgezogen, beginnt bei etwa 0, bleibt nahe bei 0 bis Layer 10, steigt dann an und erreicht bei Layer 22 einen Wert von etwa 380.
